title: Breeding bird point counts
description: Ten-minute point counts of breeding birds at five invented forest points over three mornings in June 2024, with the number of each species heard or seen and its distance. Every point and count is invented.

archive:spatialCoverage.description: Five points 250 m apart in one invented forest block.

archive:methods: One observer stood at each point for ten minutes starting within an hour of sunrise, in calm dry weather, and recorded every bird heard or seen within 100 m.
